Imagine you are riding your bike up a really steep hill. It feels heavy, right? Your legs have to push super hard just to keep moving. Now, imagine you are zooming down a flat road. You don’t need to push hard at all; you can just coast and go fast!

A bicycle gear system is like a set of **magic levers** for your legs. It helps you choose between two things: **power** or **speed**.

### 🚲 The Two Main Parts
1. **The Front Gears (near your feet):** These are the big circles attached to your pedals.
